info.title: MGate API
info.description: MGate self-hosted mail platform API. Endpoints that are not implemented yet answer 501 with the error code `not_implemented`.

201.description: App password created with cleartext secret

put.description:
The current password is a password guess like a login: it goes through the same throttle
(failure counters per client address, address + mailbox and mailbox, the per-login lock,
in-flight caps; `429` + `Retry-After` at a limit, delayed before), and the session that
submits 5 wrong ones is ended (`401`).

400.description: Invalid current password or policy violation

401.description: Unauthorized, or the session was ended after too many wrong current passwords

429.description: Too many failed password checks from this client address, for this mailbox from it, or for this mailbox from addresses it was never used from; or too many checks in flight. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds

404.description: No such active session of this account

post.description:
Validates the chain (order, expiry), that the key belongs to the server certificate and,
when `sans` is given, that the certificate covers those names; stores it with the private
key encrypted at rest. The worker writes it to `/certs/live/<name>/`, lists it in the
Traefik certificate file and — when it covers the server host name — installs it as the
default certificate used by SMTP/IMAP, usually within a minute. Uploading again under the
same name replaces an earlier upload (renewal); names of ACME-managed certificates are
refused.

200.description: Replaced an earlier upload with the same name

409.description: The name belongs to a certificate that is not an upload

422.description: Invalid chain/key, expired, or not covering `sans`

get.summary: Current license state (edition, entitlements, activation state).

parameters.name: activation_id
parameters.description: Id returned by the activation-start call

429.description: Too many failed attempts from this client address, for this login from it, or for this login from addresses it was never used from; or too many attempts in flight. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds

post.summary:
Stages an upload: the raw request body (name in `?filename=`, type in `Content-Type`), or
`multipart/form-data` with the file in the field `file`. Returns the id for
`attachment_ids` of `/send` and `/drafts`.
post.description:
Limits: one file at most `max_upload_bytes` (413 `attachment_too_large`), at most 30
staged files and `max_staged_bytes` per mailbox (413 `upload_quota_exceeded`), at most 3
concurrent uploads per mailbox (429), a global cap (507 `spool_full`). A staged file
expires after `MGATE_WEBMAIL_UPLOAD_TTL`.

delete.summary: Removes a staged upload (foreign or unknown id: 404).

post.summary: Creates a group (a name already in use: 409).

get.summary: Lists contacts (at most 10 000), ordered by name.

post.summary: Creates a contact (duplicate address: 409; more than 10 000 contacts: 422).

get.summary:
Prefix search over names and addresses for the composer (1–64 characters, at most 10
results; `%` and `_` match literally).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Prefix of a name or address (1–64 characters).

get.summary:
Exports contacts as CSV (default; columns `Name,Email,Phone,Group,Notes`, cells that could
start a spreadsheet formula are defused) or vCard 3.0 (`format=vcard`).

post.summary:
Imports vCard or CSV text (≤ 1 MiB, ≤ 2000 entries per call, upsert by address; invalid
addresses are skipped and counted).

put.summary: Updates a contact; `group` replaces the membership (empty or absent clears it).

delete.summary: Deletes a contact (foreign or unknown id: 404).

get.summary:
Lists drafts, newest first (header fields only; `text`, `html` and `attachments` are
filled by `GET /drafts/{id}`).

One draft with body (editor-ready sanitized HTML, remote image URLs removed) and
attachments.

put.summary: Replaces a draft (the response carries the new id; the old one is gone).

delete.summary: Deletes a custom folder together with its messages (system folders: 409).

get.summary: Lists messages of a folder, newest first, with optional search and filters.
get.description:
The list view is small (a few recipients and short fields per message) and is streamed like
a message: its render-budget share and the per-mailbox in-flight slot are held until it has
been written.

get.summary:
Reads a message: sanitized HTML (remote resources counted, `cid:` images inlined), text,
attachments, trusted authentication results. Marks it read unless `peek=true` or the user
preference says otherwise. Messages above `MGATE_WEBMAIL_MAX_RENDER_BYTES` are returned
headers-only with `too_large: true`; so are the text or HTML body above their own caps
(the part is dropped and `too_large` is set).
get.description:
The JSON is serialized inside the render budget (a multiple of the message size) and
streamed: the budget share for its length and the per-mailbox in-flight slot are held until
the connection has written the last byte, with the same idle/total timeouts as downloads.

parameters.name: peek
parameters.description: Do not mark the message as read.

delete.summary: Deletes a message: moved to Trash, or expunged when already in Trash or Spam.

patch.summary:
Changes `\Seen`/`\Flagged` and/or moves a message. Returns the summary at its (new)
location, or 204 when the moved message cannot be located.

get.summary:
Downloads attachment `index` (always as an attachment, never inline). Messages above
`MGATE_WEBMAIL_MAX_RENDER_BYTES` are refused with 413 `message_too_large`.
get.description:
The render budget and the per-mailbox in-flight slot are held until the connection has
written (or dropped) the last byte; a client that stops reading is cut off after 30 s
without a new chunk, its connection closed after 60 s without progress, and any transfer
after 10 minutes.

get.summary:
Raw RFC 5322 source as `message.eml`. Messages above `MGATE_WEBMAIL_MAX_RENDER_BYTES` are
refused with 413 `message_too_large`.
get.description:
The message is streamed in 1 MiB pieces (`BODY.PEEK[]<offset.length>`): the gateway holds
a few pieces per download at most (the one being written, the next one queued), each with
its render budget, until the connection has written them. The per-mailbox in-flight slot
stays taken until then. A client that stops reading is cut off: no new piece after 30 s, the
connection closed after 60 s without progress, the transfer after 10 minutes (the response
is then aborted, not truncated cleanly).

get.summary: Full-text search across folders (prefix matching by the server's FTS).

post.summary: Sends a message and stores a copy (with its `Bcc` header) in Sent.
post.description:
Errors: 403 `sender_not_allowed` (`from` is not an address of this login),
403 `sending_suspended`, 404 `attachment_not_found`, 413 `message_too_large`,
422 `validation_failed` / `recipient_rejected`, 429 `rate_limited`, 503 `upstream_unavailable`.

post.summary: Creates a signature (a name already in use: 409; more than 20: 422).

put.summary: Updates a signature (foreign or unknown id: 404; name taken: 409).

delete.summary: Deletes a signature (foreign or unknown id: 404).

get.summary: Threads of a folder (newest 1000 messages), most recent activity first.
One thread (any member id works), at most 50 members, oldest first.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Thread id (message id of a member)

get.summary: Liveness of the API process (does not touch the database).

inline.description: Inline part (e.g. an image shown in the HTML body).

AuthUser.description:
The authenticated principal as shown to the SPA (`GET /api/v1/auth/me` and a successful
login). Role values are `snake_case` names (`user`, `domain_admin`, `super_admin`) — the
single casing convention for the whole public API.

domain_id.description:
Domain the principal is scoped to: the mailbox's domain for `user`, the (single) granted
domain for a `domain_admin` with exactly one grant, `null` for `super_admin` or a
`domain_admin` with several/no grants (the SPA then falls back to a domain picker).

BuildInfo.description:
Build identity of the running backend.

There is exactly one backend build, so there is nothing here to distinguish builds: the
licensed edition is a runtime property, reported by `/api/v1/system/info`'s `edition` and
`/api/v1/system/entitlements`.

group.description: Group name (created on demand; empty clears).

name.description: Full name, 1–200 characters, `/` separates levels; not `INBOX`.

spam_today.description: Number of spam messages caught today.

is_primary.description: Whether this is the license's primary domain.

id.description: Draft id (message id in the drafts folder; changes on every save).

EntitlementsResponse.description: Entitlements as exposed to the admin UI.

available_features.description: Pro features the backend provides (enabled only if listed in `features`).

ErrorBody.description: Body of every MGate JSON error response: `{"error": { ... }}`.

oneOf.description:
Extra context; shape depends on `code` (e.g. `{"reason": "..."}` for validation/conflict
messages).

message.description:
Human-readable message in Russian (UI default locale; not meant to be i18n'd by code —
clients branch on `code`, not on this string).

request_id.description:
Request id, also echoed in the `X-Request-Id` response header; quote it when reporting a
problem so it can be matched with server logs.

FeatureInfo.description: A Pro feature the backend provides (listed whether or not the current licence enables it).

FolderInfo.description: A folder of the folder list.

id.description:
Folder id: `inbox`, `sent`, `drafts`, `spam`, `trash`, `archive`, or `f-<base64url>` for
other folders (URL-path-safe).

name.description:
Full hierarchical name (`/`-separated, decoded). Special folders are localized by the
client from `role`.

skipped.description: Skipped entries (invalid address, over the limit).

LicenseActivationSession.description:
Link-based Pro upgrade in progress: open `checkout_url` in a browser, then poll
`GET /api/v1/admin/license/activation/{activation_id}` every `poll_interval_secs` seconds until
the licence becomes active or `expires_at` passes.

checkout_url.description: Vendor page where the administrator completes the upgrade.

expires_at.description: After this moment the activation id is no longer valid.

LogEvent.description:
One `mgate:logs` entry (`mgate-agent`'s syslog listener), as sent over
`GET /api/v1/admin/logs/stream`.

src.description: Source IP/host as seen by the daemon, when applicable.

LoginRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/auth/login` body: full e-mail + password, plus a TOTP code once the server
has answered `totp_required` for the same credentials (one endpoint for both steps).

email.description: Full e-mail address (admin or mailbox user).

password.description: Password (or, for a mailbox user, an app password).

totp_code.description: 6-digit TOTP code; omitted on the first call, required once `totp_required` was returned.

authentication_results.description: The `Authentication-Results` header added by this server (`null` otherwise).

bcc.description: Bcc (only in the user's own copies).

too_large.description: The message (or its HTML) is too large to display: headers only.

id.description: Opaque message id (valid for this mailbox only; changes when the message moves).

thread_count.description: Messages in the thread (1 when unthreaded).

NewAppPasswordResponse.description: New app password response with cleartext secret.

PassdbRequest.description:
Request of `POST /internal/v1/dovecot/passdb` (format shared by the Dovecot Lua passdb and
`mgate-agent checkpassword`).

local_port.description:
Listener port the connection arrived on (`%{real_local_port}`: unlike `%{local_port}`
a trusted client cannot override it through IMAP ID); unknown = a public listener.

password.description: Mailbox password, or one of the mailbox's app passwords (accepted for mail services only).

real_rip.description: TCP peer of the connection (`%{real_remote_ip}`), informational.

remote_ip.description: Client IP (as Dovecot attributes the login; may be forwarded by a trusted peer).

secured.description:
Whether the client connection is TLS-protected or trusted (bool, or Dovecot's
`%{secured}` expansion: non-empty string = secured).

service.description:
`imap`, `pop3`, `smtp` (Postfix SASL), `sieve`, `doveadm`… The Lua passdb sends
`protocol`, `mgate-agent checkpassword` sends `service`.

user.description: Login as typed by the client (full e-mail address).

reason.description: Short reason written to the Dovecot log (never contains secrets).

user.description: Canonical username (address as stored) on success.

PassdbResult.description: Outcome of a passdb lookup (names match Dovecot's `PASSDB_RESULT_*`, see the Lua script).

Role.description:
User role. Wire representation is `snake_case` (`super_admin`, `domain_admin`, `user`) — the
single JSON casing convention for the whole public API.

blocked_remote.description: Remote resources found; the client keeps them blocked until the user allows them.

html.description: Safe HTML (render in a sandboxed frame; remote URLs are kept).

id.description: Ignored (legacy); the id is in the path for `PUT`.

keep_attachments.description: Attachment indexes of the previous draft version to keep (`PUT`).

bcc.description: Bcc (envelope only; kept in the Sent copy).

draft_id.description: Draft this message was composed in (removed after sending).

forward_attachments.description: Attachment indexes of the forwarded message to include.

from.description: Sender address (must be allowed for the mailbox; empty or absent: the mailbox itself).

from_name.description: Sender display name (default: the mailbox display name).

keep_draft_attachments.description: Attachment indexes of the draft to keep.

reply_to_id.description: Id of the message being replied to (as returned by the message APIs).

saved_to_sent.description: Whether the copy was stored in Sent.

SystemInfo.description: Public system information (no secrets; shown on the login page and "About").

id.description: Thread id (message id of the earliest member in the folder).

message_count.description: Number of members in the folder window.

messages.description: Members, oldest first (at most 50; in thread lists the 10 newest).

otpauth_uri.description: OTPAuth URI for QR code generation.

UpdateMessageRequest.description: Change flags or move a message.

UploadCertificateRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/admin/certificates` body: a custom (e.g. corporate PKI) certificate.

cert_pem.description: PEM chain: server certificate first, then intermediate(s). PKCS#12 is not accepted.

key_pem.description: Unencrypted PEM private key of the server certificate (PKCS#8, PKCS#1 or SEC1).

name.description:
Name, used as the directory under `/certs/live/` (lower-case letters, digits, `.`, `-`,
`_`; spaces become `-`). Optional: defaults to the certificate's first host name.

sans.description:
Host names the certificate must cover (cross-check; wildcards in the certificate match
one label). The stored host names always come from the certificate itself.

mark_read_on_open.description: Mark messages read when opened (default true).
